# Welcome to the Statistics Campus Blog

The Statistics Campus Blog focuses on statistical methods, data analysis, and their practical applications in academic research and professional contexts.

It offers scientifically grounded articles, practical examples, and reproducible tutorials, primarily using R. The content is designed for students, researchers, and professionals who wish to deepen their understanding of statistical methods, develop their analytical skills, and critically interpret statistical results.

## What You Will Find Here

Our articles cover a range of topics, including:

Descriptive and inferential statistics Regression analysis and statistical modeling Analysis of variance (ANOVA) Multivariate statistical methods Statistical visualization and interpretation Reproducible data analysis with R

Each article aims to connect statistical theory with practical applications, addressing methodological assumptions, analytical procedures, and the interpretation of results.

## Our Approach

Statistics Campus emphasizes methodological transparency, reproducibility, and critical interpretation. Rather than focusing exclusively on statistical significance, the articles also consider effect sizes, uncertainty, model assumptions, and the substantive relevance of analytical findings.

R is the primary software environment used throughout the tutorials.

## Languages

Statistics Campus publishes content in English, German, and Greek. Articles are developed and translated progressively, depending on the topic.

## Statistics Campus – Main Website

This Quarto blog complements the main Statistics Campus website, which provides further information about statistical support, data analysis, and research-related services.

**Main website:** <https://statistics-campus.com/>
